message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) for the described case.

Facts: Prison staff (李某) used physical force on inmate (谭某) causing facial injury (nose fracture) resulting in light injury (轻伤二级). This is intentional injury (故意伤害). The staff is a law enforcement officer (prison guard). The act was not part of a group fight, not a mob. So label is 故意伤害.

Check correction lessons: There's a rule about "故意伤害;组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;强迫卖淫" but only when both present. Not relevant.

Also rule about "故意伤害;聚众扰乱社会秩序" when group. Not relevant.

Thus only 故意伤害.
